🧠 BTCUSDT SMC SETUP — LIVE

BTC remains structurally bullish, but price is pressing into buy-side liquidity. The setup is to wait for confirmation — not chase.

HTF READ
• Daily structure is recovering from the ~$83.9K sell-side sweep and has reclaimed ~$85K.
• 4H has expanded from the ~$84.5K–$84.7K demand area and is trading above the $85K reclaim.
• Key overhead liquidity sits around $85,428–$85,470.

1H / 15M
• 1H structure remains bullish with higher highs/higher lows.
• 15M momentum is still positive, but price is extended near the current highs.
• BTC spot is around $85,376 on the latest Binance price tick.

🎯 PRIMARY LONG
Wait for a retrace into ~$85,100–$85,250, then require bullish 15M displacement/reclaim before entry.

Targets:
→ $85,470
→ $85,650
→ $86,000+

Invalidation: sustained loss of ~$85,033, with stronger bearish invalidation below ~$84,558.

🚀 BREAKOUT ALTERNATIVE
If BTC cleanly accepts above $85,470 on 1H/4H structure, continuation toward $85,650 and $86K becomes the cleaner momentum scenario.

🔴 SHORT ONLY IF CONFIRMED
A sweep through $85,428–$85,470 followed by bearish 15M displacement and loss of ~$85,250 would open a short setup toward $85,033 → $84,890 → $84,558.

⚠️ SMC verdict: BULLISH, but currently extended into liquidity. Patience beats chasing.
